description: Create or edit the connected user’s application tracker and manual unlinked letter text. When letter_document_id is present, edit that library document through get_document and save_document; its current text is the application letter. For tracker edits provide id and expected_updated_at from list_applications. For new records provide company and title; optionally link a saved indexed job. Does not email or submit an application.
name: save_application
title: Save an application record or draft
